title: Suspicious SolarWinds Web Help Desk Java Module Load or Child Process
author: Elastic
description:
Identifies the SolarWinds Web Help Desk Java process loading an untrusted or remote native module (DLL) or spawning a
suspicious child process such as cmd, PowerShell, or rundll32. This behavior is uncommon for the Web Help Desk server
and may indicate successful exploitation of deserialization vulnerabilities (CVE-2025-40536, CVE-2025-40551), which
allow attackers to load malicious SQLite extensions and achieve remote code execution.
